blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A total of 816 barangays in Cebu Province have been declared drug-cleared, according to the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency in Central Visayas (PDEA-7). The figure covers 76 percent of the province’s 1,066 barangays, according to a report from the Provincial Information Office. The data was presented during the third-quarter meeting of […]...
